notes: Thin coverage: search returned mostly aggregators, theses and classifieds; only 3 entries had an own-site page with phone and hours. No official Nicaraguan veterinary college/association (CMVN), MAG/IPSA or university vet-hospital page listing clinics was found or usable. La Prensa article could not be fetched (client_error). Leads not verified (only names, from a Ficohsa promo PDF): Vet Life Clinica Veterinaria (Granada), VetNorte and Todo Para Tu Mascota (Esteli), Veterinaria Her Za and Farmacia Veterinaria Bienestar Animal (Leon), Clinica Veterinaria Manchas (Carazo), Clinica Veterinaria Robles / Dog Happy / Dog's House / Rances / AquaNimal (Managua), Raymari (Bolonia, Managua, phone 2264-0072 mentioned on a third-party blog). Not used: Yo Pet Clinic (suspicious, non-Nicaraguan contact number), Innova Pet's (demo site). No duty-rota page and no animal poison line found for Nicaragua.
